messages:
anya: quick sync 1: we're finalizing telemetry for auth routing UI. noticed the console wants a clickable link from a route bar to the auth identity (who paid / which SA). how do we expose identity without killing cardinality?
sam: short answer: don't send raw keys to metrics. send `identity_type` + `identity_hash` in metrics, and a separate low-qps identity event to logs for lookup.
viktor: agreed. we also need to surface `owner` (org/project) in the UI. question: should `owner` be a metric label or derived by joining against the lookup when rendering?
anya: if we join in the UI we can avoid metric cardinality but the dashboard will need low-latency joins. our frontend can call the identity-service for batched lookups when the user clicks. that keeps metrics cheap.
sam: implementation sketch: emit metric `redwood.auth.route_call` with labels `{route, result, identity_hash, identity_type, region}`. Store full mapping events to logstore: `identity_event {identity_hash, identity_display, owner_org, owner_project, created_at}`. join on click.
viktor: UX nit: for rollouts people want to see quota owner inline on hover, not only after click. can we cache frequent mappings in the console (LRU) for the top 500 identities?
anya: yes, caching top identities is fine. add TTL 24h. but must also have a fallback for orgs that ask for full history.
sam: retention policy proposal: metrics (identity_hash) 90d, aggregated metrics 365d; identity mapping logs 30d by default but flagged customers can get longer via support export.
viktor: quota routing impact: some customers use project-less API keys. For routing we need the effective owner. If project absent, we must use `org` fallback or `billing_account`. need clear precedence documented.
anya: precedence agreed in design doc: explicit project > org > billing_account > unknown. will add to schema.
dash-bot: canary deployment started: telemetry/auth-identity-schema @staging (PR #5093). health checks: ok.
sam: one more: telemetry alerts should not include identity_display to avoid PII in alert titles. use `identity_hash` only.
viktor: also add `auth_method` enum: api_key, sa_key, oauth_client, session_token. helps debug routing rules.
anya: final action items: sam to update metric schema + retention table; viktor to add precedence rules & docs; i'll wire the console lookup + cache & add tooltip text about data retention. run 24h canary then 7-day progressive rollout.
sam: opening PRs now, will include sample payload in the PR description. example metric payload in doc: ```json
{"metric":"redwood.auth.route_call","labels":{"route":"/v1/generate","result":"200","identity_hash":"f6e9a1","identity_type":"sa_key","region":"us-west1"},"value":1}```
viktor: LGTM. thanks all.
anya: thanks team, marking resolved and adding follow-up ticket (https://redwood.internal/issue/TELEM-789). :thumbsup:
